versions.content: The FrIf module shall provide an XML file that contains the data which is required for the SW identification (it shall contain the vendor identification, module ID and software version information), configuration and integration process. This file should describe vendor specific configuration parameters as well as it should contain recommended configuration parameter values. The description of the configuration and initialization data itself is not part of this specification but very implementation specific.
